The '''Battle of the Lannik system''' was a battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Sometime following the Republic [[Battle of Rodia|victory]] at [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], a campaign was launched against the Sith Empire. From Rodia, Republic forces [[Battle of Mon Gazza (Jedi Civil War)|defeated]] the Sith at [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]] before advancing through [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], [[Manda/Legends|Manda]], and [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], to [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]]. There, the Republic defeated the Sith Empire in a battle.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Lannik makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose. The battle is shown as part of a Republic campaign that began at Rodia and ended at Lannik.<ref name="EA" />
